summary: No relevant testing skill found. No mocked APIs were used. Verified the focused Threat Intel Excel upload bug end to end: backend POST /api/upload/data succeeded for exact-column XLSX files with and without empty/NaN cells, CSV uploads for QRadar/XSOAR/Threat Intel still succeeded, and the real UI flow showed the success toast plus Ingestion complete card for both Threat Intel XLSX files.

minor.issue: Current database contains stale pre-fix upload records with non-JSON-compliant NaN values, causing upload history to return 500. This did not block the reported upload modal flow, and new upload responses are sanitized, but history should sanitize or migrate legacy records.

action_items: Optional follow-up: make /api/upload/history defensively sanitize samples or migrate/delete stale upload records created by pre-fix failed uploads.
critical_code_review_comments: Confirmed /api/upload/data now uses df.head(5).fillna("").astype(str).to_dict(...), which prevents NaN from escaping in new upload responses.
Confirmed UploadModal.jsx no longer hard-sets multipart Content-Type, allowing axios/browser to send the required boundary.
Upload history still returns raw persisted records and can 500 if legacy records contain NaN.

success_rate.backend: 5/5 upload cases passed; ancillary /api/upload/history check failed due stale pre-fix data
success_rate.frontend: 2/2 Threat Intel XLSX UI uploads passed

seed_data_creation: Generated exact-column Threat Intel XLSX files (full and empty-cell variants) plus QRadar/XSOAR/Threat Intel CSV smoke files under /app/test_reports/upload_artifacts, then uploaded them through normal authenticated endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API script passed for Threat Intel XLSX full rows, Threat Intel XLSX with empty/NaN cells, and CSV uploads for qradar/xsoar/threat_intel. Browser automation passed admin login -> Upload Data -> Threat Intel source -> attach XLSX -> Ingest for both full and empty-cell XLSX files; response status was 200, rows/columns/sample were present, toast said Ingested N rows, and modal showed Ingestion complete.
rca_of_the_issue: The original failure path was consistent with multipart requests being sent without a proper boundary from the frontend and pandas NaN values from Excel empty cells escaping into strict JSON rendering. The tested fix allows axios to set multipart boundaries and fills NaN before serializing samples.
